headings.usage: Use Space Grotesk for the prominent onboarding questions and section headers to maintain a technical yet modern feel.

body.usage: Use Inter for body text, form inputs, and subtle descriptions for maximum readability.

labels.usage: Use monospace for tiny labels, data tags, and 'press Enter to continue' hints. tracking-[0.2em] uppercase.

colors.rules: No generic gradients. Use pure high-contrast colors (Electric & Neon archetype) on a structural grayscale base (Swiss). Highlight active elements with vibrant borders and text colors.

textures.noise: Subtle SVG noise overlay on the main canvas to kill digital flatness.

components.name: AnimatedCanvas
components.description: Shared central visual state container that reacts to user inputs. Uses framer-motion for smooth causal transitions.

components.name: InputCard
components.description: Used for 'Problem', 'Role/Authority', 'Team', 'Industry'. Features glassmorphism background with a shimmering border on active state.

components.name: InvestorStep
components.description: Visual question card for investor flow. Supports multi-select and skippable logic with respectful copy ('Prefer not to say', 'Explore').

layouts.variant_a_demo: All-in-one animated canvas. 12-column bento grid where inputs (Problem, Role, Team, Industry) span specific columns and surround a central dynamic visual representing the 'Ahi state'.
layouts.variant_b_demopages: Sequential morphed layout. Problem input dominates center first. Upon completion, shrinks and moves to top-left of the canvas, revealing Role, Team, and Industry in the bento grid format.
layouts.investor_flow: Centered immersive flow. Progress indicator at top. Single large question in center with bento-style selectable options below. 'Skip' and 'Prefer not to say' subtly placed at the bottom.
layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. p-8 or p-12 for main containers.

motion.rules: No bounce. Transform and opacity only. Pair elements to share timing. Stagger entrance animations. Central state visual must react immediately (causal) as fields are filled.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text against #0A0A0A. Hover states must have higher contrast (e.g., text-white on hover).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Disable complex framer-motion transitions if true.
accessibility.keyboard: All inputs and selectable cards must be focusable (tabIndex=0) and support Enter/Space to select.

media.laptop_reveal: The final state triggers a cinematic zoom into the MacBook frame, fading out the surrounding UI.

3d libraries.usage: If needed for the central Ahi state, use Framer Motion 3D for simple, performant card spins or positional depth instead of heavy Three.js, to ensure snappy form performance.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create two routes: /demo (Variant A) and /demopages (Variant B).
Implement a shared 'OnboardingCanvas' component that both demo variants use to render the fields.
For Variant A, render all fields simultaneously in a bento grid.
For Variant B, implement a multi-step state where Step 1 is just 'Problem', and Step 2 morphs the layout into the Variant A grid.
Role and Authority must be combined into a single logical block/input card (e.g., a dual dropdown or split form).
Team and Industry should use compact searchable dropdowns/comboboxes (Shadcn popover + command), not huge lists.
The central visual (laptop context) must react dynamically as fields are filled (e.g., glowing brighter or unlocking layers).
In the Investor flow, ensure all questions have a 'Skip' or 'Prefer not to say' option.

End the investor flow with a visual 'CRM Handoff' confirmation screen that states 'Tailored brief created. Connect database to save.', redirecting to the specific persona URL (Venture, Strategic, etc.).
Use framer-motion extensively but strictly adhering to the timing and easing rules provided.
Ensure all components use generic HTML/Tailwind for layouts and Shadcn for interactive logic, highly customized for the dark vibrant theme.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts (unless for a specific focused question like Investor flow), simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) and 1px delicate borders (border-white/10).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute for testing.
